modern: Either it is a well-ordered universe or a chaos heaped together, but still a universe. But can a kind of order exist in you, and disorder in the All? And this too when all things are so separated and dispersed and in sympathy.
original: Either it is a well-arranged universe or a chaos huddled together, but still a universe. But can a certain order subsist in thee, and disorder in the All? And this too when all things are so separated and diffused and sympathetic.
notification: Either it is a well-ordered universe or a chaos heaped together, but still a universe. But can a kind of order exist in you, and disorder in the All?
notification_original: Either it is a well-arranged universe or a chaos huddled together, but still a universe. But can a certain order subsist in thee, and disorder in the All?

explained.summary: Whether the universe is ordered or a random heap, it’s still a universe. And it makes little sense to find order in yourself but suppose disorder in everything else, when all things, however far apart, are connected and affect one another.
